narr: A deep southerly flow across New Mexico ahead of an upper trough over the southwestern U.S. brought heavy rain to the Gila region and the Trout burn scar.
ev: Debris flow off of the Trout Fire was flowing down Pictograph Canyon across Highway 35. The road was impassable. Radar indicated 1.5 to 2 inches of rainfall above the road.
lsr: Debris flow off the Trout Fire, out of Pictograph Canyon, across HWY 35. Road was impassable. Radar indicated 1.5 - 2.0 in. rainfall.
